title: A direct answer replaces guessed hurt

captions.physics: Ending an expectation of unspoken answers
captions.emotions: Feeling closeness through a willing response

meaning: You can end expecting the other person to guess an uncomfortable feeling and gently name your answer, preserving closeness through a freely given response.
text: Death in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in ending an expectation that something important will be understood without words. Strength in energy supports courage to speak gently and directly, neither hiding feeling nor presenting it as an order. The Lovers in emotions bring closeness through voluntary response. You can leave guessing as a way of obtaining understanding; an actual request can be heard without becoming a compulsory test of love or participation.

For example, after an unpleasant joke you stop answering “Guess” when asked about your silence. Instead, you name specific words and explain how they sounded. **A directly named feeling does not assign the other answer**. You can ask that the remark not be repeated and hear an actual response. Closeness is felt through talking without a hidden task to guess the only correct explanation. Yet a voiced feeling does not require immediate agreement with your entire judgement or denial of an intention to joke.

Pressure returns if new directness becomes a reason to obtain an exact reaction. Ending guessing then creates another examination with its conditions now spoken aloud. Constructive Strength helps preserve gentleness after an awkward answer. You can firmly name a request and continue hearing the other; free closeness requires no silence about discomfort but cannot be bought through a compulsory remark permitted only to be repeated.
